review_notes: Read the whole file and the cylinderCross lemma family (add_left, zero_left, smul_right, add_right, finset_left, self), labeledCommonDepth_self, treeFeatureTag_cross, and the uses of cylinderCross_sub_left. The file has no @[simp] declarations. The simp calls are all `simp only` or `simp_rw` with explicit sets. I found no loop or competing-rule problem. Both findings are modest: they concern a missing or misplaced canonical lemma and an ad hoc side condition. I did not run Lean, so I could not check whether the suggested simp sets close the goals.

findings.excerpt:
lemma cylinderCross_sub_left (a b c : ℕ →₀ ℝ) :
    cylinderCross (a - b) c = cylinderCross a c - cylinderCross b c := by
findings.problem: This is the subtraction companion of `cylinderCross_add_left`, but it sits in an unrelated leaf file instead of the file that holds the other left-linearity lemmas. The sibling `cylinderCross_zero_left` and `cylinderCross_add_left` (and the `_right`/`smul`/`finset` variants) are scattered over several files. The `sub` rule is only reachable here, so users who write `simp only [cylinderCross_add_left, ...]` (as in TensorWardMeasurability) cannot include the subtraction rule without importing this file. Callers in TensorSiteComparison, TensorPerturbationCost and TensorAmplitudeComparison each `rw` it by hand. The `sub_left` rewrite also has no matching `neg`/`sub_right` rule, so a subtraction on either side has no uniform normal form.
findings.proposed_change: Move `cylinderCross_sub_left` next to `cylinderCross_add_left` in ReplicaEnergyCovarianceBound.lean. Add the missing `cylinderCross_sub_right` and, if wanted, `cylinderCross_neg_left/right`. Then either tag the family `@[simp]` (pushing `cylinderCross` through +, − and smul, which is terminating and one-directional), or at least collect it in one place so that `simp only [cylinderCross_add_left, cylinderCross_sub_left, cylinderCross_add_right, cylinderCross_sub_right]` is available. Optionally prove it directly via `Finsupp.sum_sub_index`.
findings.benefit: One canonical linearity rule set for `cylinderCross` lets later proofs expand differences with a single `simp only` call instead of manual `rw`/`linarith` steps. Only the shared lemma file is needed to import it.

findings.excerpt:
simp only [labeledCommonDepth_self,
    show ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), i.1 ≤ n from fun i => Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt, ite_true]
findings.problem: The `simp only` set contains an ad hoc inline proof of the side condition `i.1 ≤ n` for `i : Fin (n + 1)`. Core already provides exactly this fact as `Fin.is_le`. Also, `labeledCommonDepth_self`, the rule that turns `labeledCommonDepth n x.2 x.2` into `n`, is a plain lemma that every caller feeds by hand to `rw` or `simp only` (ReplicaEnergyCovarianceBound, EnrichedFieldCap, CascadeFreshMoments). It is a safe, terminating, assumption-free rewrite.
findings.proposed_change: Replace the `show ... from ...` term with the existing lemma, i.e. `simp only [labeledCommonDepth_self, Fin.is_le, ite_true]`. Mark `labeledCommonDepth_self` as `@[simp]` at its declaration, so plain `simp` or `simp only [labeledCommonDepth_self]` normalizes the diagonal depth.
findings.benefit: The simp set is shorter and uses a named library rule instead of re-proving it inline. The diagonal-depth normal form is available by default in the cascade covariance computations that currently re-list the lemma each time.

evidence.excerpt: theorem is_le (i : Fin (n + 1)) : i.1 ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.is_lt
lemma labeledCommonDepth_self (n : ℕ) (v : LabeledLeaf n) : labeledCommonDepth n v v = n := by
